zh-CN.title: 空间治理更清晰
items: 管理员可分别开放聊天、广场与探索，并始终保留至少一种交流方式
未认证成员可按正常参与、只读或禁止入群三档管理

en.title: Clearer space governance
items: Administrators can manage Chat, Square, and Explore while keeping at least one communication mode available
Unverified members can follow full, read-only, or no-group participation policies
